title: Reaching out for the Jedi
description: One by one, ships plummet from the sky, all taken out by the emperors lightning. Rey rolls over onto her back and watches the Resistance fall. "be with me," she pleads as Jedi from the past speak out to her. Through the power of the Jedi, Rey is given the strength to rise up and again face down the nefarious Emperor Palpatine.
